p1_b0.ocr: The data table presents an analysis of auditory function outcomes following cell transplantation, specifically focusing on average pre-operative air-bone gap (ABG) measurements across different patient groups. The table distinguishes between two cohorts: TEES (n = 53) and MES (n = 100), providing a comparative overview of initial cases and subsequent improvements in hearing capabilities post-transplantation.

p1_b1.ocr: Notably, the average pre-operative ABG ± SD (dB) for the TEES cohort is recorded at 24.7 ± 8.1, while the MES cohort exhibits a slightly higher average of 25.0 ± 8.2.
